messages:
riley: Repro: sample-app fails on Vite+Cloudflare Pages after we switched to dual-publish. The streaming retry path explodes with header shape errors. Node demo (CJS) unaffected. Anyone seen this pattern?

zoe: Can you paste the error + package.json exports?

riley: Error: 
```
TypeError: headers.get is not a function
    at makeAuthHeaders (dist/esm/auth.mjs:66:18)
    at attemptRequest (dist/esm/retry.mjs:38:9)
```
package.json (simplified):
```
"main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
"module": "dist/esm/index.mjs",
"types": "dist/types/index.d.ts",
"exports": {
  "./": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "default": "./dist/esm/index.mjs"
  }
}
```

pat: Edge/bundlers choose the import/default entry. Our ESM builds assume Fetch Headers; some internal helpers still expect Node IncomingHttpHeaders. That mismatch explains the error.

lee: Two paths: 1) add explicit "edge" conditional export pointing to dist/edge.mjs that wires fetch adapters; 2) refactor code to a single authored ESM with a tiny platform adapter interface and emit platform-specific entrypoints during build. I prefer #2 because it avoids maintaining separate logic trees.

zoe: Agreed on adapter interface. Proposed API: src/platforms/{node,edge}.ts export adapter implementations. Core code imports a platform-agnostic entry like `./platform` which build tooling rewrites to the correct file. During build emit dist/platform-node.mjs and dist/platform-edge.mjs and use exports map with node/edge branches. Example: 
```
"exports": {
  "./": {
    "node": "./dist/platform-node.mjs",
    "edge": "./dist/platform-edge.mjs",
    "default": "./dist/esm/index.mjs"
  },
  "./types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts",
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```

pat: For require() compatibility, ship a tiny CJS shim at dist/cjs/index.js that re-exports the ESM default. That keeps old consumers working without a full CJS build.

lee: Watch out for bundlers: Vite/Rollup may prebundle and resolve conditional exports at build time incorrectly if consumers deep-import platform files. Document root import usage and recommend `import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk'` only.

riley: Also noticed Bun resolves exports differently in dev. We need to test against Bun + Node 18 and against esbuild-based bundlers.

zoe: Typings: add explicit "./types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts" export and include a small `index.d.ts` at package root that re-exports dist types. This handles editors that follow exports strictly. Add `typesVersions` mapping for older TS.

pat: CI plan: add matrix job that runs Node18 (native ESM), Node16 (CJS shim), Vite dev build, Cloudflare Pages emulator, and Bun. Also add a sample-app smoke test for streaming+retry: simulate 500 then success, verify headers and retry semantics.

lee: One extra safety net: include a dev-mode runtime check that asserts adapter selection matches environment features and prints a clear error: 
```
if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
  if (!platformAdapter.verifyRuntime()) {
    throw new Error('Platform adapter/runtime mismatch: see SDK docs')
  }
}
```

packager-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412 - adds platform adapters, platform-node/edge entrypoints, types subpath export, root index.d.ts, CJS shim, and CI matrix.

riley: Thanks all. I'll add a short migration note for customers and update sample-apps CI to run the smoke test on PRs. Will link back here when PR lands. :rocket:
